scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Rational and convex-hull checks independently corroborate finite cases; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The covariance is in hub-anchored coordinates; arbitrary graph families and nonuniform potential laws are excluded. The boundary-window distribution requires the dimension-scaled common-edge parameter to converge (or subsequences). An unindexed equivalent treatment remains possible. Finite checks are only corroborating evidence.
title: A Laplace–Gaussian boundary layer in weighted book Lipschitz balls
